final_text:
The release build failure was caused by R8 stripping generic type signatures during code shrinking and obfuscation. When `object : TypeToken<List<Book>>() {}.type` was evaluated in `CatalogRepository.kt`, Gson could not determine the type argument at runtime because the generic signature was missing, throwing `IllegalStateException`.

To fix this, the following rules were added to [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-B-r2/work/app/proguard-rules.pro):

- `-keepattributes Signature`: Preserves generic signatures across classes and methods so `TypeToken` can resolve parameterized types.
- `-keepattributes *Annotation*`: Preserves runtime annotations.
- `-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` and `-keepclassmembers class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }`: Retains `TypeToken` subclasses and their members.
- `-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }`: Preserves the model class fields so Gson can deserialize JSON keys to model properties.
